items.title: Steps to create an x-axis data figure with example (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Steps to create an x-axis data figure with example: a main subheading of 22.3.2 Pie Chart, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 200-201.

blocks.text: Farz karein hum aik enzyme ki activity naap rahe hain, 5°C, 10°C, 20°C, 30°C aur 40°C par.

items: Qadam 1: variables pehchanein. Independent variable (x-axis): temperature (°C). Dependent variable (y-axis): enzyme activity ki raftaar (rate).
Qadam 2: scale aur range tay karein: x-axis ki kam se kam aur zyada se zyada qeemat aur waqfe; yahan 5°C, 10°C, 20°C, 30°C aur 40°C.
Qadam 3: axes ke naam likhein: x-axis 'Temperature (°C)', y-axis 'Enzyme activity (μmol/min)'.
Qadam 4: nuqte (data points) lagayein: (5°C, 2 μmol/min), (10°C, 4 μmol/min), (20°C, 7 μmol/min), (30°C, 5 μmol/min), (40°C, 3 μmol/min).
Qadam 5: formatting theek karein: tick marks barabar faasle par hon, aur nuqton ko lakeer se jor kar rujhan dikhayein.

blocks.alt: Line graph: The effect of temperature on enzyme activity. X-axis Temperature (darja C), 0 se 45 tak 5 ke qadmon mein; y-axis Enzyme activity (micromol/min), 0 se 8. Narangi nuqte (5, 2), (10, 4), (20, 7), (30, 5) aur (40, 3) halki neeli lakeer se jure hue, grid ke saath.
blocks.caption: Enzyme activity par darja hararat ke asar ka x-axis data figure (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke temperatures x-axis par barabar faasle par hain kyunke waqfe milte julte hain, lekin 5, 10, 20, 30, 40 ke darmiyan farq 5, 10, 10 aur 10 hai. Sahih scale par (jaisa graph mein) 5°C se 10°C ka faasla baqi faaslon ka aadha hai. Graph se pata chalta hai ke enzyme ki activity 20°C par sab se zyada hai.
